author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Rhode Island forced five turnovers and scored 28 fourth-quarter points to beat Elon 31-10 Saturday in the CAA opener for both teams. The Rams improved to 2-1 overall and extended their home winning streak to 16 games in their first 2026 contest at Centreville Bank Stadium in Pawtucket.

The game was tied 3-3 through three quarters before Terrence Campbell finished an 18-play, 98-yard drive with a one-yard touchdown. Tyler Budge then connected with Marquis Buchanan for a seven-yard score, and Mitchell Garner returned an interception 30 yards for a touchdown to give URI a 24-3 lead.

Rhode Island intercepted four passes, its most in a game since 2013, and also blocked a field-goal attempt. Josh Hamel made a career-long 51-yard field goal in the third quarter. The Rams scored 14 points off turnovers despite finishing with fewer total yards than Elon. URI now visits conference opponent Stony Brook on September 19.
dek: The Rams forced five turnovers and scored all 31 points after halftime in their first 2026 game at Centreville Bank Stadium.
headline: Rhode Island defense fuels 31-10 CAA win over Elon
